issue.description:
ADR-004 requires bead-rs-ci to run a pinned `cargo +1.85 check --all-targets` lane on every run, with the lane's toolchain equal to the manifest's `rust-version` — drift between them is a CI failure, not a doc nit — so the declared 1.85 floor is tested on every run instead of asserted (the ADR records that the floor is currently honest only by luck, with no CI lane exercising it). No open bead owns the lane (beadrs-778fbff1 covers arch-suffixed release artifacts only). Add the lane to the bead-rs-ci WorkflowTemplate in declarative-config, derive the pinned toolchain version from Cargo.toml's rust-version and fail the lane on mismatch, and keep the README/AGENTS.md MSRV statements in lockstep with the manifest.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add the pinned MSRV verification lane with manifest-drift gate to bead-rs-ci (ADR-004)
